subject: Nanotechnology
title: Biofuel Cells with Nano Enzymes
description: A micro-lesson that makes Biofuel Cells with Nano Enzymes usable.

hook.text: A fuel cell powered by glucose from your blood — nano enzymes on electrodes generate electricity from body sugar.

buildup.text: Glucose oxidase immobilized on carbon nanotube electrodes converts glucose to electrons efficiently.

discovery.text: Direct electron transfer from enzyme to nanotube eliminates the need for chemical mediators — simpler design.

twist.text: Enzymes denature over days — the fuel cell loses power as proteins unfold on the electrode surface.

climax.text: Nanozymes — synthetic nanoparticles mimicking enzymes — never denature and work for months in implanted devices.

punchline.text: Your blood sugar powers a nano fuel cell — the body becomes the battery.

quiz.question: What advantage do nanozymes have over natural enzymes in biofuel cells?
options: They do not denature, maintaining function for months instead of days
They are more selective for glucose than natural enzymes
